title: 100 Lost Species

typography.note: Hairline-weight serif headline over a light grotesk paragraph; the contrast is weight and stroke, not size alone.

color.note: Probe recorded no text colours (content sits behind a WebGL layer); white ink and white-outlined controls read from the screenshot, no saturated accent.

layout.note: Centred stack: icon tile, three-line serif title, short paragraph, outlined counter button.

why: Light-weight editorial serif title with a quiet grotesk paragraph and square outlined controls on pure black: a restrained intro worth lifting for long-form pages. Tentative: everything past the intro is a WebGL experience the probe could not read, and the site is dark-only.
avoid: Dark-only scheme and the WebGL journey behind the intro; take only the serif/grotesk pairing and the outlined button.

title: 1367 Studio

typography.note: Geist regular headline with a grey second line, Geist Mono uppercase for body copy, buttons and the agent pill.

color.note: Probe reports white as largest area, render shows a cream video field; one hot orange for the primary CTA and outlined pill.

layout.note: Centred silhouette video, headline bottom-left, mono blurb and CTA bottom-right; nav split around a centred wordmark.

why: Geist with Geist Mono is an open, Cyrillic-ready pairing, and the orange appears only on the book-a-call button and the outlined agent pill. Mono body copy reads as a technical voice without a third face.
avoid: WebGL video hero and uppercase mono for running copy; keep mono for labels.

title: AAT Architecten

typography.note: One grotesk at two sizes: a 40px statement and 16px body, grey nav for de-emphasis.

color.note: White and warm black #1d1d1b with grey #ababab nav; no chromatic accent, ink doubles as accent.

layout.note: Statement pinned bottom left, tall photograph right; mobile stacks text over image.

why: Architecture-office restraint: a single grotesk, warm black on white, grey nav labels and a statement-plus-photo split that stacks cleanly on mobile.

title: GoShuin: Goshuin Map & Journal for iPhone

typography.note: Georgia display at 129px with a Georgia subtitle, system sans for UI and small tracked caps for metadata.

color.note: Paper tones with slate ink and a deep slate cover panel; the most saturated colour is the bronze #756449 border, used for rules.

layout.note: Book spread: text page left, illustrated cover right, a paging bar (Previous / page select / Next) at the bottom.

why: An app landing built as a paged book: serif title page, hairline rules, underlined text links instead of filled buttons, and a pause-motion control. Paper and slate tones with bronze rules feel chosen, not default cream.
avoid: The pixel-dithered Japanese pattern art is specific to this product.

title: Agence web lyon : création de site internet et design graphique

typography.note: One superfamily: Neue for headings and nav, Platt for body; the condensed wordmark is a logo, not a heading face.

color.note: Warm off-white with three muted pastels (blue-grey, mauve, sage) as project panel backgrounds; no saturated accent, mauve taken from panel backgrounds.

layout.note: Left half holds wordmark, intro and social row; right half is a horizontal strip of project panels in muted colours.

why: Dusty pastel panels (blue-grey, mauve, sage) on warm off-white give project colour coding without one saturated hue. Nav items carry a small coloured dot keyed to each panel.
avoid: The ultra-condensed wordmark and the horizontal panel strip; both break on long Russian words and on mobile reading.

title: ALMADA LABEL

typography.note: Neutral grotesk for all UI, a single italic serif for collection labels such as "New Arrivals".

color.note: White and warm near-black; the primary button reuses the ink, no chromatic accent.

layout.note: Split full-bleed photo hero, centred spaced wordmark, short plain nav on both sides.

why: Restrained fashion shop: a plain grotesk UI with one italic serif label and an ink-filled square button, letting photography carry the brand.
avoid: Font names are Shopify aliases, so the real faces are unknown; the spaced-out wordmark is a logo, not a heading style.

title: Banham

typography.note: Ivar Headline and Ivar Text carry headings and body; centred serif headings at 48px read calm and established.

color.note: Probe areas are skewed by the full-bleed video (black 67%); the page itself is white with a slate #333e48 for buttons.

layout.note: Centred serif headline over a video band, then centred serif section headings on white.

why: An all-serif heading and body system (Ivar) on white with one slate button colour shows how a heritage brand can feel editorial instead of corporate.
avoid: Video hero and floating booking pill; mobile is dominated by a cookie modal.

title: Bedford Square

typography.note: Light flared serif (300) for headings and nav over Aktiv Grotesk body.

color.note: Warm brown-black with cream type; no saturated hue, accent is the pale stone of the Apply button.

layout.note: Aerial video with a cell-bordered top bar (menu, weather, wordmark, apply, login).

why: A ruled top bar split into bordered cells is a tidy nav pattern, and the warm brown with cream type is a dark scheme with real temperature. Tentative: the capture shows only the intro video and loader.
avoid: The intro loader and video-only first screen.

title: Bennett & Clive

typography.note: Inter Bold at 150px with -10px tracking, all caps, used as a right-aligned client list.

color.note: White type over video; probe ink is white because the heavy text sits on footage.

layout.note: Full-bleed video with stacked client names as the navigation.

why: Tentative: a single Inter weight at huge size as the whole interface is striking, but it depends on video behind it and offers little beyond the scale.
avoid: Video hero, ultra-tight caps that will overflow with long words, white text over moving footage.

title: boostlab

typography.note: One proprietary geometric sans at regular weight for the 64px headline and body; no bold needed.

color.note: Cool grey with navy sections and one bank blue for the second headline line and primary button.

layout.note: Headline in the centre cell of a visible hairline grid, with logo tiles occupying other cells.

why: Hairline grid hero with the headline in one cell and portfolio logos in others; cool grey and a single bank blue. Tentative: corporate tone and the coloured second headline line.
avoid: The highlighted second line in every headline.

title: Bortoletto Studio

typography.note: A single light grotesk at large size for the statement, regular for nav; the face name is obfuscated by the host.

color.note: White with soft charcoal type and a light grey pill button; no hue, imagery provides colour.

layout.note: Centred statement paragraph, one pill CTA, then full-width project tiles in a two-up grid.

why: A type-only hero of one centred statement sentence and a single soft pill CTA before the work grid. Tentative: generic grotesk, face names obfuscated in the probe.

title: Brandon Yasin

typography.note: Neo-grotesk throughout; 12px caps UI, 90px headings per probe.

color.note: Warm olive-brown ground with sand text; one colour pair only.

layout.note: Tiny four-corner header and a single centred image on an empty warm field.

why: Tentative: the warm dark #2c2922 with sand #c3beb1 is a designed dark palette with real temperature, but the screens show little structure beyond it.
avoid: Dark-only; tiny caps UI and centred single-image screens.

title: We are Büro

typography.note: One grotesk from 16px body to 270px headlines with heavy negative tracking (-5% to -7%).

color.note: Strict black and white; colour comes only from the work shown.

layout.note: Full-viewport showreel or 3D object with a floating dark pill bar; content sections below in a 1405px container.

why: A single grotesk carrying everything from body to 270px tight-tracked headlines in strict black and white; the floating pill bar is a compact nav pattern. Tentative: the screenshots show only the video/3D intro, so the content sections are judged from probe facts.
avoid: Video and 3D intro, extreme negative tracking that breaks with long words.

title: Cris Araújo (Designer)

typography.note: Neue Montreal at 64px regular for statements, one face throughout.

color.note: Black on white; colour only inside embedded client videos.

layout.note: Large regular-weight statements stacked between full-width case-study videos.

why: Tentative: regular-weight 64px statements between full-width case videos give a calm rhythm, but most of the visual identity belongs to the client work.
avoid: Embedded client reels (including a crypto product) carry gradients and tilted marquees; take only the statement scale.

title: Creative Reference Library

typography.note: Neue Haas at one weight: 15px tight-leaded paragraphs and ~90px numerals, parenthetical counts as labels.

color.note: Warm grey #a1a098 ground with white type; white is the only accent (button fill).

layout.note: Three text columns, a large CRL /V.01 (2026) line across the middle, counts list bottom left.

why: Tentative: warm grey with white Neue Haas and (n) count labels is a distinctive library look; mobile rendered blank and the probe reports WebGL.
avoid: White on #a1a098 fails contrast; 14.8px/14.8px leading is too tight for reading.

title: Death to Robots

typography.note: Inter Display caps with a Libre Caslon italic phrase in the same headline; Caslon for body.

color.note: Near-black and blush pink only; pink is both text and accent.

layout.note: Inset video with the centred headline over it; body copy in large pink sans below.

why: Tentative: grotesk caps meeting a Caslon italic in one line, in blush on near-black, is a clean duotone pairing; dark-only with a video hero.
avoid: One highlighted italic phrase per headline, video hero, dark-only scheme.

title: Dropbox Brand Guidelines

typography.note: Wide, heavy Sharp Grotesk headlines over neutral Atlas Grotesk body; width contrast instead of serif contrast.

color.note: White base with brand blue for type and links and colour-blocked panels (plum, pale blue, coral) per chapter.

layout.note: Square type panel centred on a visible blue hairline grid; chapters scroll as colour blocks.

why: Brand-guidelines site that is itself a docs layout: chapters as colour-blocked sections and a visible hairline grid. Wide display grotesk with a neutral text grotesk is a clean two-face system.
avoid: The multi-hue chapter palette is brand-specific; keep one hue for a content site.

title: Enric Badrinas

typography.note: One grotesk at one size (16px) for name, nav and caption; the photograph is the only hierarchy.

color.note: Black on white, no accent; colour comes only from the photographs.

layout.note: Single centred portrait image with a one-line caption; two-link nav top right.

why: The quietest possible frame for images: one face, one size, a two-item nav and a single caption line. A reference for gallery and case-study pages where content must lead.

title: Estudio Niksen

typography.note: Single grotesk; 42px headings with -1.47px tracking, small uppercase nav and 16/24 body.

color.note: Light grey and black only; probe has no saturated colour, so accent is black (white button on photography).

layout.note: One-row nav with handwritten logo centred, edge-to-edge campaign photo with caption and button bottom-left; 2px radii.

why: Brand storefront that lets photography carry colour while the UI stays one grotesk in black on light grey, with near-square 2px radii and a plain one-row nav.
avoid: Newsletter popover over the hero; arrow on the sign-up link.

title: Farm Minerals

typography.note: Regular-weight geometric grotesk at 86/52px with tight leading, set against small uppercase Arial captions.

color.note: Bone #f4ede6 and deep olive #404f1d; heaviest text is bone-on-olive in the hero, so ink is the olive used on light sections; accent is the lighter olive text.

layout.note: Headline top-left, secondary claim and outlined CTA bottom-right, product render centred between.

why: A two-colour bone-and-olive system with one regular-weight grotesk for every heading; outlined uppercase CTA with dot markers and a three-item centred-logo nav keep the page quiet.
avoid: The 3D product render hero and uppercase Arial body copy; GSAP ScrollTrigger reveals.

title: FORUM Cases

typography.note: Wide-tracked semi-condensed caps for headings and nav, a serif wordmark, Barlow body.

color.note: Near-black and light grey only; no saturated colour, accent taken from the slate #4c4d53 text tone.

layout.note: Centred tracked headline and square button over a full-bleed product video.

why: Tentative: disciplined monochrome product page with square tracked-caps buttons, but the identity is a video hero and heavily tracked caps.
avoid: Tracked caps everywhere, video hero, dark-only.

title: Half the Sky

typography.note: One classical serif in tracked small caps for wordmark and nav; scale stays small so the reliefs carry the page.

color.note: Stone grey ground with warm grey ink; no chromatic accent, the darkest text tone serves as accent.

layout.note: A hairline-ruled 4-up grid of carved portrait tiles under a centred one-row nav.

why: Warm stone-grey palette and hairline-divided grid make a quiet, tactile surface; a good reference for a neutral with real temperature and a nav that stays out of the way.
avoid: Tracked-out caps everywhere and the low ink contrast (#66645c on #dddcd7) fail the 7:1 floor.

title: Hope Cancer Resources

typography.note: Geometric Brandon Text at 800 for headlines and tracked caps buttons, regular for body.

color.note: Deep navy and white with one ribbon blue on buttons and the logo mark.

layout.note: Video hero with a giant translucent ribbon glyph, two pill CTAs and a stats band overlapping the fold.

why: Nonprofit site with a single ribbon blue on pill CTAs and a stats band, a direct pattern for a support organisation. Tentative: tracked caps buttons, overlapping glyph and a mobile render that showed an injected network-warning overlay.
avoid: Tracked all-caps buttons and the giant translucent glyph over video.

title: Inkfish

typography.note: Martian Mono at 12-14px for everything; NT Dapper only in the wordmark.

color.note: Black page, white mono text, highlighted rows inverted to white; the probe reports #ffffff as largest area, but the render is black.

layout.note: Two-column work index (client, numbered title) as the home page; hover row inverts.

why: The home page is a mono work index: client column, bracketed numbers and an inverted highlight row, a dense list pattern that works for archives. Tentative: dark-only and all-mono body text.
avoid: All-mono body copy and the dark-only scheme; use the list pattern, not the palette.

title: ITSUA

typography.note: Tight-tracked 120px Space Grotesk headline over mono nav, labels and buttons; size does the hierarchy.

color.note: White with near-black ink; cobalt #2f4cff on the primary button, plus green and rust used for stats and status.

layout.note: Dashed vertical column guides, headline left with abstract and CTA right, ruled stat strip below.

why: A spec-sheet aesthetic done cleanly: huge Space Grotesk headline, mono metadata, visible column guides and square ink buttons with a cobalt arrow cap.
avoid: Numbered [00]-[05] nav and section markers, tracked caps labels and three status colours; take the scale and grid, not the ornament.

title: Creative Branding & Web Agency in Orlando

typography.note: One grotesk in uppercase for statements plus a mono for small metadata; the giant wordmark is a drawn logo, not a font.

color.note: Saturated grass green field with near-black ink and cream #ffffeb; accent is the pale aqua announcement chip, the only coloured control.

layout.note: Edge-to-edge wordmark, two-line uppercase statement left, mono metadata in the four corners.

why: Grotesk-plus-mono pairing with mono metadata pinned to the corners is a reusable trick for a tool site footer or header. Tentative: the identity is a vivid green field with illustration, outside the preferred palette.
avoid: Vivid full-green background, illustrated mascots, all-caps statements.

title: UI/UX Designer for Fashion & Music Brands

typography.note: Pixel-cut display caps over a neutral grotesk body, with Xanh Mono for nav and labels; three faces, each with one job.

color.note: Pure black on white; no hue at all, buttons are black with a hard drop shadow.

layout.note: Centred headline, a short paragraph and one CTA; work collage sits below the fold.

why: Strict black-on-white with a pixel display face shows how far one distinctive headline face can carry a page. Tentative: three typefaces, a blur effect on the headline and → on every button.
avoid: Blurred headline, drop-shadow buttons and the → suffix on every CTA.

title: Moab Adventure Tours

typography.note: Eczar's sharp, slightly calligraphic serif for headings over Geologica body at 18px.

color.note: Sand base, deep teal ink and oxblood nav; oxblood is the accent, sand is the button fill.

layout.note: Video hero with a wavy edge into a teal intro band; headline left, tracked-caps kicker and copy right.

why: Eczar plus Geologica is an open-source pairing with real character, and sand, teal and oxblood come from the canyon landscape rather than a default. 130-140px section gaps keep the long page calm.
avoid: Tracked-caps kickers and nav labels, the wavy section edge and Montserrat in the logo lockup.

title: No Jiggery

typography.note: Bricolage Grotesque Bold at 120px tight against a friendly Figtree body at ~20px/1.5.

color.note: Pale aqua and deep teal with a hot pink #fa2a6f for headlines and round buttons.

layout.note: Rounded aqua hero panel with headline left and custom line illustration right.

why: Tentative: a good open pairing (Bricolage Grotesque with Figtree) and readable 20px body, but pink headlines on aqua plus illustration is louder than the profile.
avoid: Pink headline colour, arrow buttons everywhere, illustrated hero; neither face has Cyrillic in Fontsource.

title: Fine Art Landscape Photography by Jan Erik Waider

typography.note: Light serif intro line over tracked Montserrat caps for titles; Merriweather appears as a third face.

color.note: White with charcoal and grey text; a muted gold for the photographer's name link and a short rule.

layout.note: Three-column photo grid with caps title and grey location caption under each image.

why: Image grid captions as bold caps title plus grey location separated by a gold dash, with a muted gold used only for one link and a rule. Tentative: three typefaces and tracked caps throughout.
avoid: Three typefaces and tracked-caps titles on every card.

title: The Obsidian Assembly

typography.note: High-contrast swash display serif at poster scale against a plain neutral grotesk for labels and body.

color.note: Near-black #151415 with parchment #f1eade; a bronze gradient wash in the hero; no saturated accent, so accent is the parchment used on buttons.

layout.note: Staggered three-line display headline over an obsidian render with tilted photo cards at the edges.

why: Parchment-on-near-black palette with a swash serif display and a neutral grotesk; the palette is reusable for a premium dark scheme. Tentative: three faces, dark-first, and the display face will not survive long Cyrillic words.
avoid: Swash display at body-level headings, gradient wash, tilted cards, 2s transitions.

title: Odyssée

typography.note: Light Times-style serif for headings and the tagline, small tracked Basel Grotesk caps for nav; one serif, one sans.

color.note: Warm white with navy as the only colour, used for ink and the menu; no black.

layout.note: Full-bleed portrait video with the nav row set across the vertical middle; section gaps of 120-240px.

why: Navy ink on warm white replaces black entirely, and a light serif with small grotesk caps gives a quiet clinical luxury. Spacing runs on a clear 24/40/120/240 scale.
avoid: Mid-viewport nav over video and the close-crop face video; both are brand theatre.

title: Olha Uzhykova. Design Director

typography.note: Austin high-contrast serif for h2 with Satoshi body, per probe facts.

color.note: Charcoal ground with cream text, a cream panel and sage #b1c0a0 / #568778 greens.

layout.note: Pill nav top right; content not rendered in either screenshot.

why: Tentative: screenshots caught only the preloader, so tags rest on probe facts (Austin serif with Satoshi, charcoal, cream and sage); worth a re-probe.
avoid: Unverified visually; dark-first with no light variant observed.

title: Onseis Studio

typography.note: Small uppercase grotesk headings against justified uppercase mono copy; a script face is used only for the start-a-project link.

color.note: Oat #f0e9dd with charcoal ink and a #212121 ticker bar; probe has no saturated colour, so accent is the darkest text; a small teal dot marks the CTA.

layout.note: Three-column intro statement, then a staggered horizontal strip of project images with mono captions.

why: Warm oat ground with charcoal mono captions and a staggered project strip gives a print-studio feel with very little ornament. Tentative: three typefaces and justified uppercase mono body fail the reading rules.
avoid: Justified uppercase mono paragraphs, the script CTA, the marquee booking bar; Lekton has no Cyrillic.

title: The Quaker School at Horsham

typography.note: Huge (226px) soft serif display paired with its own sans sibling for body at 18.6px; one family, two voices.

color.note: Ivory and near-black only; no saturated accent in the probe, so the accent is the ink colour.

layout.note: Full-bleed classroom video with a screen-wide serif headline at the bottom; section gaps 220-444px.

why: A soft serif display set screen-wide over video, with a matching sans for body and a short plain-label nav. Very generous section gaps (220-444px) make each block read as a chapter.
avoid: Video hero and the 226px display; scale the headline down for content pages.

title: Point Of View

typography.note: Tight bold Inter headlines with JetBrains Mono measurement annotations (D = 50,0).

color.note: Probe says black 60%, but screenshots read near-white #fafeff with black type; grey #a1a4a6 annotations, no chromatic accent.

layout.note: Spaced POINT OF VIEW title with optical-measurement lines, centred portrait, centred bold statement.

why: Tentative: eyewear story told with optician measurement marks in mono around tight bold Inter; witty, but colour facts conflict with the screenshots.
avoid: Braille glyphs inside headings and letter-spaced title; probe colours look inverted.

title: Right Hemisphere

typography.note: One soft grotesk (PP Mori) at 75px uppercase spread across the full width, regular weight only.

color.note: No saturated text or button colour in the probe; accent taken from the orange #ff7136 project panel.

layout.note: Full-width spaced headline, contact block bottom right, then a two-column project list with years set vertically.

why: Very airy type-only hero with a single regular-weight grotesk and a plain five-item nav; the project list below keeps the same quiet rhythm.
avoid: The word-spread headline relies on short English words and will not survive long translations.

title: Ross O'Neill — Freelance Web Developer in Perth, Australia

typography.note: One face throughout; hierarchy from a large medium-weight statement headline against 16px body.

color.note: Black and white with a #f5f5f7 card grey; the probe has no saturated colour, so accent is the black pill button (red appears only in the logo).

layout.note: One-row nav with black pill CTA, statement headline, then a swipeable row of 32px-radius project cards; 160px section gaps.

why: Plain statement-headline hero with a one-row nav and consistent 160px section gaps; a clean baseline for a freelancer page. Tentative: competent but generic, with no accent and nothing that beats the current theme.
avoid: DM Sans lacks Cyrillic; arrow appended to links; identical rounded project cards.

title: RuntimeWire

typography.note: Newsreader semibold headlines and serif deks over Inter UI; mono only for tracker counters and the terminal theme.

color.note: Cool grey surfaces with blue-black ink; burnt orange #bb4d00 for the Featured kicker, links and the logo dot.

layout.note: Lead story left, ruled numbered More Features rail right, subscribe bar under a one-row nav.

why: A real news front built on open faces: Newsreader headlines, Inter UI, a cool neutral and one burnt-orange kicker, with a light/dark/terminal theme switch in the header.
avoid: Tag chips in several pastel colours and the HOT badge add noise; keep the single orange.

title: Sam Goddard // Design Engineer

typography.note: Condensed editorial serif caps at 86px with swash ligatures against a 12px Geist Mono UI.

color.note: Neutral charcoal with one light grey for all text and rules; no accent.

layout.note: Ruled mono header and footer bars framing a full-width serif statement over a halftone portrait.

why: Tentative: serif display caps with a mono UI framed by thin rules is a strong engineer-portfolio pairing, but it is dark-only.
avoid: Dark-only; double-slash separators and the halftone canvas are decoration.

title: Second Ride

typography.note: One rounded humanist sans at two weights; hierarchy comes from photo captions, not the type.

color.note: Near-black page with a single mustard tone (0.6% of area) lifted from the moped paint.

layout.note: Two full-height photo panels, one per product line, with a frosted floating nav bar.

why: Split full-bleed hero that routes straight to the two product lines, with captions set quietly over a dark gradient. Kept tentative: dark-only and the type system is a single generic sans.
avoid: Dark-only scheme and the glassy floating nav; neither has a light counterpart.

title: Signal-A Studio

typography.note: Hairline condensed Editorial New caps set against heavy grotesk caps in the same justified line; mono for nav and meta.

color.note: Pure black on white; no chromatic accent in the probe, black doubles as accent.

layout.note: Six-column underlined nav row, full-width justified statement, then a centred media block.

why: A justified all-caps statement that switches between hairline serif and heavy grotesk word by word, on plain white with a ruled mono nav; a sharp lesson in weight contrast without colour.
avoid: Three faces and a text-scramble load effect; the justified caps would break with long Russian or Spanish words.

title: Stash

typography.note: Custom slab wordmark at full width; Helvetica for UI and deks, Space Mono for card titles and meta.

color.note: White and black with one highlighter yellow #ffff00 for the shortcut key and play control; probe ink is the grey dek colour.

layout.note: Full-width wordmark, ruled section header with bracketed pager, horizontal article cards.

why: A directory with real editorial structure: ruled section headers, bracketed [ ← ] pagers, mono meta lines and one yellow highlight on otherwise black and white.
avoid: The giant slab wordmark is a logo, not a heading style; grey #8a8a8a deks are below 4.5:1.

title: Stéfano Girardelli

typography.note: Archivo at 600-700 with tight tracking for headlines and regular for body; wide-tracked caps for the reel link.

color.note: Charcoal with one raspberry accent used on a single word and the full stop.

layout.note: Game screenshot fills the hero, headline bottom-left with an inline avatar pill.

why: Single-family Archivo system with one raspberry accent; shows a heavy open grotesk holding a dark page. Tentative: dark-only, numbered 01-07 nav and a highlighted word in the headline.
avoid: Numbered nav labels, highlighted headline word and the dark-only scheme.

title: SUPERMODELS: Top AI models. One app.

typography.note: Medium Manrope with very tight tracking (-6%) for headlines over a plain DM Sans body.

color.note: Warm off-white #f7f6f2 body with a black hero; no saturated accent in the probe, so accent is the most saturated text colour, warm beige #ded5c5.

layout.note: Full-width wordmark, then headline and CTAs left with an image carousel of 24px-radius cards.

why: Warm off-white and near-black neutrals with 24px pill chips and square cream CTAs; the section gaps (144–214px) set a calm rhythm for a tool landing. Tentative: four faces loaded and tracked caps on nav and eyebrows.
avoid: Tracked-out uppercase nav and eyebrow labels; arrows on every CTA; extra Onest and Impact Label faces.

title: Luxury Safari Experiences in Greater Kruger & Sabi Sand

typography.note: Hairline-weight (220) serif caps at 120px against plain Inter; the weight contrast does the luxury work.

color.note: Stone background with olive (#5c6e21) as both secondary surface and link colour; dark olive ink instead of black.

layout.note: Staggered two-line headline offset across the hero, intro copy indented to a second column; section gaps 100-196px.

why: An ultra-light serif display over Inter with olive used for both ink and accent: one temperature, no black anywhere. Section gaps step from 100 to 196px, so the page reads as a slow sequence.
avoid: The 220-weight display fails at small sizes and on low-contrast photos; keep it above 48px and on solid surfaces.

title: Architectural Photographer in Tokyo, Japan

typography.note: EB Garamond for headings, italic accents and body copy; Inter only for small UI. Italic swashes do the emphasis.

color.note: Warm off-white with near-black #141414 headings and a bronze #6d5a33 used for italics, outlines and rules.

layout.note: Inset photo hero, then a left-aligned serif intro with generous leading.

why: An open Garamond with a warm off-white and one bronze accent for italics and outline buttons; long body copy at 1.8 leading reads like a book.
avoid: Tracked italic caps labels and an always-visible Enquire pill; body grey #6b6b6b is below 7:1 on the off-white.

title: Animation Studio London

typography.note: A single variable grotesk does everything, from the 175px stencil-cut wordmark to slash-separated nav.

color.note: Cool light grey with a full red field (33% of area) as the brand surface; red-orange for the active nav item.

layout.note: Edge-to-edge reel with a screen-wide wordmark pinned to the bottom; inline slash-separated nav top right.

why: Inline slash-separated text nav with a dot marking the current page, and a wordmark that spans the viewport. Tentative: vivid red identity and video-led hero sit outside the taste profile.
avoid: Full red fields and the bottom-pinned giant wordmark; they are brand-specific.

title: Tricota

typography.note: Public Sans only: screen-wide wordmark in near-black on black, large light statement in cream.

color.note: Warm near-black with cream type and a cream tab; the wordmark is tone-on-tone.

layout.note: Tone-on-tone giant wordmark above a centred two-line statement; a vertical side tab for contact.

why: Warm near-black with cream text and a tone-on-tone wordmark: a dark scheme with temperature, using one open face. Tentative: dark-only and the wordmark has almost no contrast.
avoid: Tone-on-tone wordmark (fails contrast) and the dark-only scheme.

title: Creative communications agency in Geneva

typography.note: One grotesk, lowercase nav at 20px; no visible heading scale on the first screen.

color.note: Black and white chrome; colour comes only from project photography.

layout.note: Full-bleed project image with a single centred row of lowercase nav.

why: Tentative: lowercase single-grotesk nav floating over full-bleed work is clean, but the first screens show no type scale or sections to learn from.
avoid: The whole first screen is a client image; nothing beyond the nav is reusable.

title: Watson

typography.note: Condensed grotesk wordmark, a bold text serif and a hairline sans mixed inside one sentence; footnote numerals link the nav.

color.note: Pure black on white; images inline in the headline are the only colour.

layout.note: Centred 320px wordmark, then a centred serif sentence with inline images and underlined links.

why: Footnote-numbered nav and a centred sentence that mixes serif and hairline sans with inline thumbnails; a bold editorial voice in black and white.
avoid: Three faces (obfuscated as ba/bu/ca) and inline images in headings; probe flags WebGL though the page reads as static.

title: Wedding Invitation

typography.note: Geometric Stack Sans headings with a script Italianno word layered in; Zen Old Mincho for Japanese.

color.note: Two near-identical light greys with charcoal text; no chromatic accent.

layout.note: Offset photos with curved crops, vertical side labels, large date set in the headline face.

why: Tentative: a one-off event page with good grey rhythm and offset photo crops, but four faces and a script overlay are past the profile.
avoid: Script overlay word, four faces, letters animating in; a single-event microsite.

title: Wonder Vision®

typography.note: One grotesk at 70px regular for the statement, 16px/24px body.

color.note: White and black chrome; probe ink is white because text sits on the showreel.

layout.note: Full-bleed CGI reel with a boxed Play Showreel button; mobile shows the statement above the reel.

why: Tentative: a plain regular-weight grotesk statement and a square split play button are clean, but the page is a CGI showreel first.
avoid: The CGI video hero and coordinate overlays.

title: 一卦

typography.note: System serif headline and subtitle at 57px over system sans UI text; zero webfonts, the contrast still holds.

color.note: Warm paper with near-black ink and a black pill as the only button; muted grey #65645e for secondary text.

layout.note: One centred symbol, headline, two-line subtitle and one Cast button; hairline rules frame header and footer.

why: A single-purpose tool reduced to a serif sentence, one black pill and hairline-ruled header and footer on warm paper. Shows a calm serif-plus-sans system built from system fonts.
avoid: Soft radial glow behind the symbol; drop it.

title: Zenarate

typography.note: Book-weight variable serif at 64/48px with -1px tracking over a medium-weight Manrope body; mono only for small chips.

color.note: White and #f6f6f4 surfaces, near-black ink, #d0d0ce hairlines; butter yellow #fde173 appears only on the logo tile.

layout.note: Full-bleed photo hero with centred serif headline; floating white pill nav; 16px cards and 200px pill buttons.

why: A B2B product page that leads with a book-weight serif over a quiet Manrope body, white pill nav and hairline-bordered 16px cards; the serif/sans contrast carries the personality as the taste profile asks.
avoid: The full-bleed close-up photo hero and the italic highlighted word in the headline.

title: Shahed interceptor with auto-guidance

typography.note: Tight-tracked Inter Display headline against small uppercase Geist Mono HUD labels; mono carries the technical voice.

color.note: Off-black with warm grey ink; signal orange appears only on the contact button frame and borders.

layout.note: Bottom-left headline over a dim product video, mono telemetry block top-left, hairline-framed nav.

why: Disciplined sans plus mono pairing with one signal-orange accent reserved for the CTA, a clean model for a technical tool's chrome. Tentative: dark-only, video hero and GSAP scroll scenes.
avoid: Defence subject matter, dark-only palette and the scroll-driven video sequence; lift only the mono label system and the accent discipline.
